snippet.title: Binding of Isaac Update Reveal
snippet.description:
Florian has been working on special elite versions of Bosses in the Binding of Isaac (Wrath of the Lamb only) also some bugfixes.
In this video: The Hollow and the Duke of Flies

check out the next videos about the update: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AQEDDKAMhMc
